last_comments.ORIONIDS: Jumped well, pushed along to lead, kicked clear on          straightening to win easily.
last_comments.GODSPEED: Always well back and did not run on.
last_comments.GOLD VELVET: Always well back and did not run on.
last_comments.MI BLANCO: Taken back at start, one pace throughout.
last_comments.SUCH A HAPPINESS: Settled behind midfield, angled out on straightening and    worked home strongly.
last_comments.RUGBY DIAMOND: Began fairly, settled leaders back, one paced in straight.
last_comments.CARE FREE PRINCE: Sent forward to take the rail and led by 3/4L, maintained   lead and only headed inside final 50M, held on for 2nd.
last_comments.VICTORY MASTER: Slotted in just behind midfield, 4-1/4L behind 3 wide with  cover, made slight ground in the run home.
last_comments.BALAY BALAY: Settled to race in midfield, 3-1/4L behind along the rail,  kept on one paced in the run home.
last_comments.MEISTERSTUECK: Pushed and raced prominently, wide until improved to race   outside the lead at 1100M, weakened passing 250M.
last_comments.THE SHOW: Settled to race in midfield, 3-1/4L behind 2 wide, checked  near 1100M, slight dash at 350M, one paced thereafter.
last_comments.ELECTRIC LIGHTNING: Taken back and travelled at the rear, 7L behind 3 wide with cover, made impressive ground and ran home strongly.
last_comments.WHY WHY: Shifted across behind runners shortly after start, dropping to last pair but kept away from fence. Remained at the rear till well into the straight before running past tired       horses. Lame left front and left hind legs.
last_comments.BRAVO WATCHMAN: Chased leaders 2-wide, quickened up nicely early straight,  led nearing 200M, stuck to task well at the front and       fended off a late challenge to keep unbeaten record intact.
last_comments.WINSTON'S LAD: Began awkwardly, recovered to race in midfield, 5th at 400M 3Ls behind leader, tracked path of eventual winner turning  in, kept finding to make it close at the finish.
last_comments.PERFECT LIFELINE: In midfield, made the turn awkwardly 900M and ended up      3-wide no cover, kept on moderately in straight, not reach  contention.
last_comments.WESTERN EXPRESS: Lunged at start losing ground, then hunted forward,         settling midfield approaching turn. Pocketed top of         straight but got split 300m and powered forward along fence to win close home.
last_comments.SIMPLY INVINCIBLE: Away quickly, pressed forward, racing wide to 1000m when    got cover 3L behind leader. Came off the bridle passing     500m and failed to respond to hard riding in straight,      giving ground rapidly final 200m.
last_comments.NEW ASIA SUNRISE: Quickly into stride from an outside draw, leading field but wide until 1150m when overtaken. Chased leader to straight, retook lead 300m out, looked winner before being run down   close to line.
last_comments.PACKING LLAREGYB: Pushed forward from inside draw, hugging rail 4L from       leader on settling. Stayed on rail around turn but ran out  of steam halfway up the straight and faded.
last_comments.HOME RUN: Settled midfield, on the rail. Raced tight at 300m and      again at 150m when taking runs. Finished solidly, and       easily held 3rd.
last_comments.THE SUPREME: Handily placed 3rd/4th early. Ran on OK early in the        straight, but 1 paced from the 250m.
last_comments.ENERGETIC CLASS: Taken up to midfield, 1 off the fence. Steadied early in    the straight, but only fair when clear and made no impact.
last_comments.PEARL WARM WARM: Very keen early and taken up to lead. Race was run by the   250m, and faded out quickly from there.
last_comments.SUPER SWEET ORANGE: Held up on heels of leader in 3rd on rails, hampered and    shuffled back to midfield 600 metres out, saved ground      turning for home,  fought on steadily without threatening.
last_comments.RISING POWER: Soon taken well behind, took closer order to 9th out wide   in back straight, circled the field to reach 6th on top of  home bend, found nothing under pressure in straight. (Lame)
last_comments.SPICY DOUBLE: Restrained behind midfield early stages, made swift         progress around slowly-run field from the 900 metres to     reach 3L 4th on the bend, made no impression in home        straight.
last_comments.SHOW MISSION: Hard ridden to obtain box seat, just held ground in final   stages.
last_comments.SHINING CHAMPION: Slow away, behind midfield on the rails, little dash 200M.
last_comments.LEAN JOURNEY: At rear along the fence, hung out badly and checked at      bends, never a factor.
last_comments.ALL TIMES LUCKY: Eased at start, took cover at rear, 2 wide, dashed well     200M.
last_comments.HONEST HORSE: Unbalanced at start and settled at rear, failed to run on   in straight.
last_comments.RAINBOW FIGHTER: Settled midfield, asked for effort on straightening, one    paced to the line.
last_comments.VICTOR EMPEROR: Settled leaders back, pushed along home turn, tried hard    but no match for winner.
last_comments.GOOD MATE: Settled midfield, under pressure at 600m and gradually      faded.
last_comments.AMAZING FEELING: Good break, led 1350m & crossed to rail, soon 1.5L clear &  keen, joined on turn & driven into stretch, all out &       headed 160m, tapered but held on to 2nd.
last_comments.MUTUAL JOY: Started well, settled midfield on rail, shifted out &       driven turning in, fought on dourly to press for minors.
last_comments.YOU HAVE MY WORD: Taken back, soon driven along 2nd last, worked to join pack 700m, last 450m & adrift turning in, eased down.
last_comments.COUR VALANT: Slightly slow to break, nudged into forward spot, settled   4th 1 off, slightly keen 700m, driven 350m & pulled centre  track, one-paced.
last_comments.ROMAN IMPERO: Broke strongly, restrained to settle beyond midfield on     inside, under riding 380m, never in contention.
last_comments.ST YAZIN: Jumped evenly, restrained to settle well beyond midfield 1  off, clicked up 400m, pulled widest, wayward in straight,   never nearer.
last_comments.RAY OF GOLD: Away on terms, eased to settle beyond midfield 1 off,       niggled 850m, ridden again 450m, found line strongly late.
last_comments.SMART DECLARATION: Raced in front of midfield, 2-3/4L off but 3 wide without   cover throughout, kept on one paced going to the line.
last_comments.ACE KING: Settled in one-off one-back position, about 2-1/2L off the  pace, ran on fairly to be closest at the finish.
last_comments.TRAVEL COMFORTS: Sent forward and led by 1/2L in a 2 wide position, kept on  going and scored comfortably by 1-1/4L.
last_comments.DR WIN WIN: Jumped well, ridden forward, staying behind pacemakers to   back stretch. Started to give ground turning for home and   faded in straight, finishing tailed out. Unacceptable       performance.
last_comments.ENREACHING: Pressed forward on jumping but caught wide without cover    entering first turn, but only 2L from leader. Came under    pressure from home turn and one-paced in straight.
last_comments.ACCLAIMED LIGHT: Steadied on jumping and shifted across behind runners,      settling one-out at rear. Dropped to last approaching home  turn, taken wide in straight but only one-paced.
last_comments.KA YING KID: Jumped OK, outpaced, dropping towards rear along fence.     Attempted to lay out turning for home but stayed on inside  rack in straight and boxed on gamely.
last_comments.MARVEL TRIBE: Bumped start, sent forward to race prominently, 2 wide      throughout, peaked early in straight and weakened gradually thereafter.
last_comments.ALL MY GAIN: Taken back to race at rear, positioned 2 wide behind        midfield, slightly improved on turn, taken wide in straight and made good progress, just missed frame. (Sustained a     wound to the right hind leg.) (See Racing Incidents.)
last_comments.A BEAUTIFUL: Away with them, raced 3 wide in midfield, failed to close   off in straight.
last_comments.MY FOLKS: Held up in midfield on rails, shuffled back rounding home   bend, baulked for a run after straightening, finished off   race nicely.
last_comments.WIN CHANCE: Moderate beginning, settled in last few, became last        rounding home bend, weakened after straightening.
last_comments.RUBY COAST: Eased to rear, harmed by the slow pace, little dash 300M,   eased down 150M.
last_comments.HOLMES LEGEND: Trapped 3 wide in midfield throughout, emptied 400M.
last_comments.GOOD CHOICE AHEAD: Eased to rear, 2-3 wide, harmed by the slow pace, dashed    well 300M, lack room 150M.
last_comments.DASHING DART: Very slow away, pushed to obtain a midfield spot 2 wide,    dashed strongly 250M despite not suited by the slow pace.
last_comments.AGILITY HERO: Slow to begin, settled towards rear and failed to run on.
last_comments.DIAMOND DRAGON: Jumped fairly and settled towards rear, ran home nicely     down middle of track.
last_comments.BOTH LUCKY: Jumped smartly, sent forward to settle behind leader,       ridden along to challenge passing 450m, hit the front at    100m before being overpowered late.
last_comments.HEARTS KEEPER: Ducked right & bumped rival but speed at break, raced handy 1 off with cover, ridden turning in, kept on evenly to nick 3rd at wire.
last_comments.MONEY MONEY: Speedy break & bustled to sit 2nd 1 off no cover, pressed   leader 700m, outpaced & 1L back turning in, soon 2L back ,  one-paced in run, lost 3rd on nod.
last_comments.GREAT SKY: Slow start & bumped rival, driven at tail, soon 2/3L        detached, some headway home turn & shifted out in stretch,  stayed on past beaten rivals.
last_comments.VICTORY MUSIC: Sluggish & bumped at start, soon improved to midfield on    rail, overraced 900m to 600m, ridden 350m, shifted out      200m, stayed on moderately.
last_comments.RAPIDASH: Moderate break, soon niggled & raced midfield 3 wide with   cover, outpaced turning in & driven, struggled in run home.
last_comments.HAPPY METEOR: Broke on top, ridden to lead on rail, travelled strongly on speed, 1.5L lead 600m, held together into straight, ridden  350m, kicked clear.
last_comments.SWISS WARRIOR: Even break, ridden to press forward, settled 2nd 1 off,     under pressure 400m, faded meekly.
last_comments.RUN FORREST: Away well, eased to beyond midfield spot 3 deep, ridden     750m, under vigorous drive 500m, made ground very late.
last_comments.KEEP MOVING: Very awkward start and shifted out, settled to race in      one-off one-behind position 2L off, slight dash before 200M then flattened.
last_comments.COMPASSION STAR: Settled in fore of midfield, sat 3-1/4L off the lead 2      wide, kept on going and finished off well to the line.
last_comments.LINE SEEKER: Eased shortly after start and shifted across behind         runners, dropping to last. Not much room top of straight,   shifted out 200m to get clear running and finished          strongly.
last_comments.ARCHIPPUS: Jumped OK, held, settling behind midfield in one-out        position. Switched out turning for home and boxed on fairly without looking dangerous.
last_comments.COUNTRY MELODY: Got off with field but not pushed, settling behind midfield along rail. Switched out turning for home to get clear      running but found little under pressure.
last_comments.KEY WITNESS: Ridden to get forward position, settling along rail 3L from leader. Switched out turning for home, looked chance        passing 200m before run ended.
last_comments.MAGIC LEGEND: Hard ridden to lead on settling before crossing to fence    800m and slowing pace. Kicked 2L clear passing 300m and     kept finding under pressure to hold off late challenge.
last_comments.HOUSE OF FUN: Broke well, ridden to hold rail before checked 800m but     holding box seat. Set off after leader on straightening but only one-paced final 200m.
last_comments.HIGH FIVE: Broke well, restrained and taken in for cover, settling at  rear in one-out position. Taken to centre track on          straightening for home and finished strongly.
last_comments.DARING FIT: Jumped with field, pressed forward but away from fence 2L   from leader. Got shuffled back turning for home but kept on gamely in straight without looking dangerous.
last_comments.AEROSPEED: Jumped well, pressed forward to race outside leader on      settling. Gave ground abruptly soon after straightening for home and eased down final 200m.
last_comments.BEAR CHUM: Pushed forward, just off the leaders 2 wide, ran on well    for 2nd.
last_comments.LUNAR ZEPHYR: Pushed to take rail and led at fast sectionals, hung on     until 200M flattened.
last_comments.GAME OF FUN: Pushed along early from wide gate to settle outside leader, quickened nicely at 300m to take lead, overpowered late.
last_comments.SICHUAN BOSS: Awkward break, quickly back to last, quite keen, pulled     wide & ridden 320m, never a threat.
last_comments.RAPHAEL: Awkward start, niggled, natural pace into midfield spot on  rail, pulled off rail 280m & ridden, still green but stayed on well.
last_comments.EXCEL ONESELF: Pushed hard, settled to race inside the lead along the      rail, dropped off badly in the Straight. (Heart             irregularity)
last_comments.BRILLIANT DREAM: Slow to jump, checked at 1000M, remained at the rear along  the rail 10L behind, kept on one paced home.
last_comments.HARBOUR MASTER: Jumped OK, ridden to hold rail position, settling ahead of  midfield. Lost position turning for home, taken to centre   field on straightening, boxed on fairly.
last_comments.EXCEPTIONAL DESIRE: Jumped awkwardly and crowded losing ground, trailed the     field most of way, only went past well-beaten horses inside final 200 metres.
last_comments.CATCHMEIFYOUCAN: Pushed forward, sat 2 wide, pace good, emptied 300M.
last_comments.WONDERFUL CHASER: Trapped 3-4 wide in midfield throughout, dropped off 500M.
last_comments.CHEERFULJET: Pushed to go forward, lay out 1000m when racing greenly,    continued hanging out when racing wide without cover  must trial.
last_comments.EMPIRE STAR: Slow to jump and settled at rear, made ground home turn,    raced greenly in straight when finishing strongly.
last_comments.SUPER CLAN: Slow start & crowded, dropped to rail & bustled early, sat  back of midfield, checked off heels to 1 off & bumped rival 850m, 3 wide advance from 630m, wide home turn, plugged one pace.
last_comments.TRAVEL SUCCESSOR: Missed start slightly, ridden along to push through,        settled midfield on rail, ridden along 350m, switched       inside, faded.
last_comments.HELLA HEDGE: Ridden forward to take the rail and led by 3/4L, headed     passing 100M but ran on to take 3rd.
last_comments.HAPPY YEAH YEAH: Ridden early then eased to race in behind midfield, 6L      behind 3 wide with cover, found nothing in the Straight.
last_comments.SENSATION: Began well, ridden to hold forward position settling 2L     behind leader at first turn. Urged forward from 600m to     eyeball leader, hit front 400m, overtaken 300m, kept on     gamely until swamped final 100m.
last_comments.MODERN TSAR: Steadied soon after start and shifted across behind horses, settling at rear. Given reminder passing 600m before being  eased out of race from 500m. Bled from both nostrils.
last_comments.GOLDEN HARVEST: Bumped start, raced 2 wide, 6 lengths back at rear, same    margin back on turn, made minor progress in straight, never a threat to the first few.
last_comments.CLEVER BEAVER: Crowded out start, raced at tail, checked near 500M, made   minor progress after turning in, in traffic near final      100M, not tested thereafter.
last_comments.CIRCUIT FORTUNE: Jumped fairly from a wide gate, raced wide mainly in        midfield far side, dropped away quickly from approaching    home straight.
last_comments.SPEEDY WALLY: Prominent early, carried backward on rails early in back    straight, recovered to forward of midfield approaching home bend and sustained headway to reach 4th some 2L back        turning in, found no extra inside final 200 metres. (Bled)
last_comments.ISLAND FLYER: Moderate start from a wide gate, raced wide in midfield     around first bend and most of way down back straight,       dropped out of contention from home bend.
last_comments.MIZZEN GREY: Slow into stride, settled in last few on rails, saved       ground turning for home, forced to steady 300 metres out,   one-paced.
last_comments.PACKING STARCRAFT: Eased at start, took rail at back, harmed by the slow pace, little dash 200M.
last_comments.BOLD STITCH: Jumped well, settled off the speed, angled out on           straightening, challenged strongly at 200m and gained       control final 50m.
last_comments.DESTIN: Pushed along to settle behind leaders, asked for effort at  400m and battled strongly to the line.
last_comments.ZOOMOOL: Began awkwardly, taken back, crowded 1150m and the raced    keenly, made no impression in straight.
last_comments.PENANG HALL: Smart start, eased back to midfield 1 off with cover,       caught in traffic on bend, ridden turning in & shifted      centre track, strong headway to 2nd 120m, closed but no     threat.
last_comments.GOOD CHOI LEE: Broke in front rank, eased to fore of midfield 1 off with   cover, niggled 500m, driven turning in, found little,       plugged on.
last_comments.TEAM SWEET: Started well, taken back near rear 1 off with cover,        niggled 850m, driven 430m, some progress & edged centre,    stayed on for moderate headway.
last_comments.CHEERS CONQUEROR: Started ok, caught wide & advanced 3 deep no cover to 3rd   900m, under pressure 5th & driven 400m, outpaced & faded.
last_comments.PENNY LANE: Outpaced early, raced 3 wide midfield, lost action 400m,    eased down & unseated rider.
last_comments.ALWAYS WIN: Travelled in front of midfield, sat 3L off 2 wide,          progressed steadily and hit the line well to take 2nd.
last_comments.SHINNING MOON: Sent forward, settled to race in one-off one-back position  and sat 2L off, dropped off gradually in the Straight.
last_comments.FLYING MOOCHI: Soon emerged as leader, set steady pace to straight, headed 250M, weakened noticeably thereafter. (Lame RF)
last_comments.ULTIMATE GLORY: Jumped well, pressed forward, settling one-out, one-back.   Not much room top of straight but only one-paced when clear final 300m.
last_comments.GO BEAUTY GO: Broke well, pressed forward to lead on settling, crossing   to fence 1350m. Kicked ahead on straightening, kept finding under intense pressure final 300m to dead-heat for first    place.
last_comments.AVELLINO: Steadied soon after start and shifted across behind         runners, settling at rear but wide. Swung wide into         straight but only one-paced under hard riding.
last_comments.CLOUD NINE: Prior to the running of the event Trainer M Newnham advised that the horse would be ridden in a conservative manner in the early stages. He said he issued those instructions as CLOUD NINE had not been finishing its races off strongly when ridden forward at its most recent starts. Shortly after the start made contact with FLOW RIDER due to both runners shifting ground. Raced keenly in the early stages. Sent for sampling post-race.
last_comments.NOTHINGILIKEMORE: Cruised forward to be handily placed 4th, on the fence.     Loomed up 300m, and pulled away at 200m. Needed no urging   from that point, cruised to the line and eased late.
last_comments.HAPPY AGILITY: Eased out to sit midfield, on the fence. Kicked clear of    the main group and had no threats for 2nd, making slight    ground on winner late as he eased.
last_comments.JOYFUL MOMENTS: Taken out and early leader, before being crossed 900m.      Plugged on fairly in the straight, and swamped late.
last_comments.MR POTENTIAL: Cruised up early, midfield and 1 off the fence. Wider on    the turn and ran solidly in the straight, just missing a    place.
last_comments.FANTASTIC FABIO: Lacked early pace, soon dropped towards the rear, never a   factor.
last_comments.PROMPT EXPRESS: Moderate start, worked his way forward to assume lead on    rails at the Rock, saved ground turning for home, unable to sustain effort and overhauled inside final 200 metres.      (Lame next day)
last_comments.HIGHLAND DRAGON: Shared pace early, taken 2L back in 4th shortly afterwards, found nothing under pressure from a similar position into   straight.
last_comments.PERFECT SMART: Moderate start, travelled mainly in 5th within 3L of pace,  fought on steadily in straight.
last_comments.NOBLE BUDDIES: Settled in midfield, commenced move leaving the Rock, just  over 2L back in 5th turning into straight but baulked early on, fought on steadily inside final 200 metres.
last_comments.BEAUTY CONNECTION: Hard ridden to share the lead and clock fast sectionals,    hung on until 150M flattened.
last_comments.LUCKY PROFIT: At rear, improved around the field from 800M 4 wide without cover, weakened rounding the Home Turn.
last_comments.ELITE EXPRESS: Prominent early, dropped off badly from 700M when the pace  quickened.
last_comments.GOBI STORM: Started ok, restrained to midfield 1 off with cover,        shuffled back 600m, shifted out & driven 300m, kept on for  minor late gains.
last_comments.LAMAROSA: Rolled forward but trapped wide, allowed to improve and led at 800M, headed passing 100M but ran on.
last_comments.MASTER CERAMIBO: Bumped and badly unbalanced shortly after start, then taken to fence, settling behind midfield. Hard ridden from 500m   but ran into tight space passing 200m and steadied.         One-paced after that.
last_comments.CLUB LIFE: Broke well, ridden to hold forward position settling        outside hindquarters of leader. Put under pressure from     500m, hit front 300m but unable maintain momentum and       swamped close home.
last_comments.STRIKING STAR: In front of midfield along the fence, raced keenly in a     more prominent spot, lack turn of foot in straight.
last_comments.HAR HAR CHARMING: Hard ridden forward, trapped 3 wide, not suited by the fast pace, dropped off quickly 400M.
last_comments.PENIAPHOBIA: Rolled forward, however, under heavy pressure near the      course proper, weakened 300M.
last_comments.NOT LISTENIN'TOME: Pushed forward to settle 2Ls behind the leader, ran on      gradually for 2nd.
last_comments.AMBER SKY: Sent forward to take the lead, kept on steadily until final 250M headed by the winner, hung on for 3rd.
last_comments.BAD BOY: Tracked 1.5Ls behind the leader, found nothing when placed  under pressure.
last_comments.MR STUNNING: Tracked behind the leader nicely along the outer fence, ran on well to score comfortably by 2Ls.
last_comments.MY LITTLE FRIEND: At rear, travelled 3Ls behind the leader, ran on steadily   for 4th without any serious threats to the placegetters.
last_comments.O'SOCOOLE: Speed wide & bustled on to press early lead, sat 2nd 1 off, 1L down & driven 400m, outkicked & soon all out, faded in   run home.
last_comments.DYNAMIC VOYAGE: Taken behind from wide & niggled at tail, progress to 2nd   last turning in & driven 400m, switched widest 300m &       quickened, hung in & bumped rival 150m, closed late.
last_comments.BERNARD'S CHOICE: Slow start, raced rail back of midfield, driven 400m,       out-kicked, kept on tepidly.
last_comments.DOCTORS DELIGHT: Jumped OK, squeezed out shortly afterwards and back to      last, improved to settle near rear on rail, overracing      800m, ridden 500m, changed course 300m, found line solidly.
last_comments.UP TO YOU: Among the best to begin, restrained right back to last      1020m, slightly keen at back on rail, ridden 500m, quickly  weakened, eased from 100m.
last_comments.DON'T MISS: Even break, eased in search of a spot but unable to get in, pushed forward 1000m, settled 3rd 3 deep no cover, ridden   660m, hung out entering straight & green, outpaced.
last_comments.FURLONG DRAGON: Sent forward to take the rail and led by 1L, dropped off    gradually from 350M out.
last_comments.AMBITIOUS HEART: Raced just in front of midfield, 3-1/2L behind along the    rail, ran on gamely to finish 2nd.
last_comments.BONITO: At the rear and finished tailed out. Not a factor.
last_comments.DASHING FELLOW: Vigorously ridden from an outside draw to share early lead  but trapped 3-wide a half length behind leader. Rolled      forward turning for home to share lead passing 400m. Kept   on gamely until flattened 50m.
last_comments.RIVER BOBO: Pressed forward from widest draw, racing 3-wide 2.5L from   leader on settling. Lost position passing 1000m dropping    behind midfield but still 3-wide. Gave ground turning for   home and finished tailed out.
last_comments.RACING SUPERNOVA: Broke well, sharing early pace before settling in box seat  2L from leader. Blocked for run early in straight, got      clear 250m, kept on fairly.
last_comments.INVINCIBLE DRAGON: Began OK then ridden to find cover, settling behind         midfield in one-off position. Lost position approaching     turn, swung very wide into straight, stormed down centre    track to win close home.
last_comments.BOBO SO CUTE: Slow into stride, taken to fence settling at rear. Shaken   up turning for home but found little under hard riding.
last_comments.GOLDEN DOUBLE: Outpaced and last on settling. Trailed field to straight,   shifted out passing 300m to get clear passage and ran home  nicely.
last_comments.SPARTA: Hard ridden to lead on settling before being passed by      inside runner 1100m. Stayed a neck behind till retaking     lead 400m, but overtaken passing 250m before running on     empty final 100m.
last_comments.KELOWNA STAR: Slow into stride, taken to fence and urged forward,         settling behind midfield 6L from leader. Not much room top  of straight but only one-paced when clear.
last_comments.PERFECT ALLOY: Hard ridden to hold fence inside early leader before taking over passing 1100m. Overtaken shortly after straitening,    crowded and unbalanced 350m, gave ground quickly.
last_comments.WATER DIVINER: Began only fairly from draw 1, 4Ls back in mid-division     along rail, held ground only in straight and never going    the pace to challenge leaders.
last_comments.GREEN CARD: Eased back from wide draw and taken across to rail, towards the rear 5-6Ls off the pace at 800M, took time to pick up   on straightening, switched out 150M and best work final     stages.
last_comments.RULE THEE: Outpaced early, dropping to last pair. Well back entering   straight, forced to shift out 250m to get clear passage,    finished strongly doing best work final stages.
last_comments.ROYAL ELITE: Dropped back early and settled worse than midfield, 1 off   the fence. Checked and lost ground and momentum 350m. Only  fair to the line late.
last_comments.CITRON SPIRIT: Crowded on jumping and dropped back soon after to be worse  than midfield, 3 wide. Widest on the turn, and ran strongly in the straight. Progressed well last 100m, and was rapidly running down 1st two.
last_comments.CHEVALIER STAR: Fairly away, but recovered to go forward and be handily     placed in 4th. Gave ground rapidly from the 350m, and eased out. Unacceptable performance. Vet  Lame Off fore leg.
last_comments.LITTLE DEVIL: Settled forward of midfield, 1 off the fence. Lay out on    the turn. No kick in the straight, and eased out from the   150m.
last_comments.COURAGEOUS BROTHER: Crowded on jumping and dropped back to sit in the last      pair, 3L off the main group. Wide on the turn, and still    last at the 250m. Plodded along and picked up a couple of   slower ones late.
last_comments.LIMITLESS: Bumped start, raced at rear on rail, similar position on    turn, kept to inside after straightening, made good         progress until checked near final 100M to get 3rd.
last_comments.HAPPY PLACE: Taken back from a wide draw, raced 9 lengths back at rear,  still 6 to 7 lengths back on turn, kept to inside after     straightening, finished off evenly.
last_comments.STAR MAJESTIC: Away with them, raced 2 wide 4 lengths or so back in        midfield, improved from 750M, wider turning in, finished    off evenly in straight.
last_comments.RAGHU: Began fairly, raced behind midfield throughout, no daylight and checked early in straight, showed no progress when      clear thereafter.
last_comments.DIGITAL PIONEER: Settled in last few on rails after beginning from a wide    gate, gained closer briefly coming onto home bend, snuck up on rails turning in and went within 2L of pace 200 metres   out, unable to sustain effort final stages.
last_comments.COMMANDANT: Ridden forward racing wide on stables bend, led or disputed lead down back straight, unable to sustain effort and       weakened under pressure inside final 300 metres.
last_comments.THIS IS GLADIATOR: Jumped well, raced keenly before travelled wide in midfield in back straight, remained wide in similar position turning in, soon dropped out.
last_comments.KIROV: Raced midfield, 4Ls behind the leader 2  3 wide with       cover, ran on only fairly.
last_comments.FORZA AVANTI: Pushed forward to get a prominent position, despite         travelled wide and without cover throughout, ran on         strongly to score by 1/2L.
last_comments.HELEN'S CHOICE: Always at rear, never a factor, tailed out.
last_comments.ART OF SUCCESS: Hard ridden forward to park outside the leader, kept on     strongly until headed by the winner final 100M.
last_comments.DIGITAL GENERATION: Bumped start and lost ground, raced behind midfield 1 off   with cover, shuffled back 900m, under pump 800m &           hard-ridden on turn, no extra & eased in stretch.
last_comments.GOLD DRAGON: Tardy start, raced midfield 1 off with cover, switched 3    deep 750m & ridden along, under pump 500m & hard-ridden     turning in, found nil.
last_comments.JOYFUL PARK: Raced in midfield, 6-1/2L behind 2 wide, found nothing in   the Straight.
last_comments.BORN IN CHINA: Began fairly, raced 2 wide, 6 lengths back at rear, there   to turn, made good progress in straight without threatening the first few.
last_comments.LOVE SHOCK: Began well, raced 3 to 4 lengths back in midfield, improved from 600M, widest turning in, finished off well, lost 2nd   last stride. (Lame left front leg next day morning.)
last_comments.GLOBAL DOMINATION: Away well, outsped early, back to beyond midfield 1 off     700m, shuffled back 550m, ridden 430m, pulled centre track  straight, closed fairly.
last_comments.GREAT WISDOM: Awkward start, quickly dropped away, under heavy drive      1150m, 5L behind main pack 900m, ridden quietly until 500m, pulled widest into straight, finished off OK late.
last_comments.SUPER SIXTEEN: Cruised forward from the inside draw to be handily placed   4th, on the rail. Looked gone at the 200m, but kicked again to just miss 2nd in a head bobber.
last_comments.GLOBE TROTTER: Lacked pace, trailed the field to the 400 metres, went past beaten horses in straight. (Lame next day)
last_comments.SMART DELIGHT: Started ok & bustled forward, trapped fore of midfield 4    wide no cover, pushed on to 2nd 3 wide 650m, under pump to  hold spot, wide final turn, emptied 300m, tailed off.
last_comments.UNITY: Started ok, snagged to midfield, restrained off heels &     shuffled to 4th last 800m, continued to retreat & last      turning in, spent force & eased down thereafter.
last_comments.STRATHMORE: Sat just front of midfield, 3L off 3 wide with cover,       dropped to the rear at 400M, made good ground inside final  100M.
last_comments.ALMABABY: Awkward start, raced prominently 1-1/2L off stayed 2 wide   until taken to 3 wide at 600M, ran on once paced.
last_comments.INDIGENOUS UNION: Hampered on jumping, drove forward to be 2nd along the      2-path, pace strong, gave ground abruptly from 600M before  finishing tailed out. (Irregular Heart Rhythm.)
last_comments.PADDINGTON: Slightly slow out, unable to slot in, raced wide with no    cover in midfield, peaked turning in, weakened gradually in straight when hard run took effect. (See racing incidents.)
last_comments.REGENCY DARLING: Failed to muster and travelled in worse than midfield,      7-1/2L 3 wide and without cover from 600M, did not feature.
last_comments.GLORY HORSIE: Driven along from the widest gate, raced wide without cover in a prominent position to straight, dropped away quickly.
last_comments.DOUBLE MASTER: Well there, lost position entering straight, gave ground    steadily.
last_comments.A FAST ONE: Reared at start and jumped out riderless.
last_comments.KIM GLORY: Niggled along in midfield, ran home one-paced.
last_comments.POWER DRAGON: Ridden along wide in just better than midfield, switched    out for a run entering straight, fought on steadily without quickening.
last_comments.CHOICE EXCHEQUER: Pressed forward, sat 2 wide, benefited by the slow          sectionals, out of fuel 200M.
last_comments.MASTER PINNACLE: At back, trapped 3 wide, harmed by the slow pace, emptied   400M.
last_comments.SILVER GATSBY: Hard ridden to hold the rail in midfield, not suited by the slow tempo, never improved.
last_comments.VERY RICH MAN: Sent forward and shared lead in a 2 wide position, was      bumped heavily at 250M, did not run on thereafter.
last_comments.YO-YO DA: Pushed forward and shared lead on the rail, bumped a runner heavily at 250M, dropped off from 200M.
last_comments.BULLISH SMART: Broke well, raced in 2nd, travelled well throughout, kept   on very well in straight but couldn't hold off the winner   late.
last_comments.NITRO EXPRESS: Jumped fairly, taken to fence, settling 4L from leader      first turn. Shaken up passing 500m, hard ridden around      turn, battled on strongly under vigorous riding to win      close home.
last_comments.GO BABY GO: Chased leaders in a slowly run race, couldn't muster the    speed to be closer passing 300M, weakened from 150M. (Lame  next day.)
last_comments.ISAAC: Sat just off the pace, raced keenly when leader steadied    the tempo passing 1000M, worked to the line hard from 300M, narrowly beaten to 4th in a blanket finish.
last_comments.SANTA FE SUN: Began OK, ridden along early, settling behind midfield in   one-off position. Put under pressure turning for home but   found little, plodding home one-paced.
last_comments.GOODHEART SUCCESS: Jumped well but restrained and shifted in behind horses to  fence to be last on settling. Last into straight before     picking up the bit and finishing strongly though not ridden out final stages when tightened.
last_comments.HAPPY SOUND: Jumped well from a low draw, travelled in a prominent       position near the centre of the track, faded under pressure inside the final 300 metres.
last_comments.RATTAN: In front of midfield, 2 wide, ran on well for 2nd.
last_comments.REAL SUPREME: Prominent, harmed by the fast pace, weakened soon after     straightening.
last_comments.GOLDEN CANNON: Ridden forward to park outside the leader, despite harmed   by the fast tempo, kept on strongly until headed 100M, hung on for 3rd.
last_comments.KING'S STEED: Prominent, despite harmed by the fast tempo and travelled   wide and without cover throughout, kept on steadily until   weakened over the latter stages.
last_comments.C P POWER: Slow start & bustled forward on outer to be handy 3 wide no cover at 800m, driven wide into stretch, all out to         challenge 250m, plugged on one pace.
last_comments.GENTILIS: Broke well, taken back from widest gate, raced 3 wide with  cover midfield, wide home turn & driven 400m, kept on       evenly.
last_comments.AMBITIOUS CHAMPION: Jumped OK, ridden to find cover but held 3-wide at midfield on settling. Swung wide into straight, taken to centre      track and finished off strongly to grab minor placing.
last_comments.HEROIC GURU: No early pace and soon at rear but along fence. Improved    position approaching home turn but still well back on       straightening and only one-paced.
last_comments.MERION: Jumped on terms to be 5th just over 2Ls off the pace,       driven out 400M and kept up his chase on leaders, just      missed 3rd.
last_comments.LUCKY EVER: Settled down 3-4Ls off the pace in midfield, 3-wide trip to straight, worked home powerfully final 250M to wear down    the race favourite in the shadows of post. (Trainer :       improved performance attributable to gear change.)
last_comments.HAMMER KING: Caught wide in midfield throughout from draw 14, failed to  pick up ground turning home. (Irregular Heart Rhythm /      Blood in trachea.)
last_comments.PAKISTAN STAR: Began nicely, rolled forward but over-raced before settling 3-wide, 3L from leader. Wide around turn, bumped and        unbalanced 450m, loomed up to join leaders approaching      200m, turning one-paced final 100m.
last_comments.HIGH SPIRIT: Worked up in the barrier, lifted feet on jumping and slow   to begin. Settled worse than midfield, on the fence. Ran    flat in the straight and not pushed out to the line.
last_comments.NORTHERN FALLS: Dropped back from the jump to sit 2nd last. Never looked    like running on, and eased out late.
last_comments.BE THERE AHEAD: Slowly away, raced at tail throughout, never competitive.   (Lame right front leg next day.)
last_comments.SIR JOHN: Moderately away, raced prominently, peaked on turn,         weakened gradually in straight and eased final 100M. (Lame  right front and right hind legs; See racing incidents.)
last_comments.NOVEL START: Began awkwardly and bumped, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, failed to close off in straight. (See racing       incidents.)
last_comments.HOLY STAR: Failed to muster, favoured by the fast pace, never better   than midfield.
last_comments.DUNDONNELL: Jumped awkwardly, then settled 5Ls behind the leader 3 wide with cover, suited by the fast tempo, stormed home for 3rd  in a tight finish.
last_comments.FABULOUS ONE: Sent forward to take the fence and led by 1L at fast        sectionals, kept on strongly until final 50M headed, hung   on for 4th in a tight finish.
last_comments.WAH MAY FRIEND: Failed to respond and finished tailed of the field despite  hard ridden along throughout. (Questioned for disappointing performance)
last_comments.TOP BONUS: Away on terms, natural speed to contest lead, stuck 4th 4   deep 750m, gave ground from 650m, ridden along 500m,        dropped out meekly, eased right down 250m.
last_comments.THE CHAMP: OK break, eased from outside, trapped deep, pushed to go    forward, 4 deep near rear 750m, under significant pressure  500m, quickly a clear last, eased 100m.
last_comments.DRAGON WARRIOR: OK break but pushed early, settled fore of midfield 1 off,  roused along 650m, gradually picked up, best work late to   just miss.
last_comments.BEAUTY PRINCE: Took box-seat, sat 2L off the lead, kicked ahead passing    200M but couldn't hold off the winner's effort in final     50M.
last_comments.ELECTRONIC PHOENIX: Travelled towards the rear, 6-3/4L behind 3 wide with       cover, continued to make steady ground from straightening.
last_comments.NOBLE ALPHA: Travelled towards the rear, 8L behind 2 wide, improved      slightly rounding turn but ran home one paced.
last_comments.VANILLA: Began fairly, ridden but no speed, dropping to midfield     along rail 4L from leader. Made good ground around final    turn to be 2nd into straight, hit the front 280m, bolted    home under hands and heels riding.
last_comments.EXPEDITE: Broke well, unable to handle early pace and slipped back to rear in one-off position. Was not asked for an effort until straightening for home when taken to centre track and ran   on steadily.
last_comments.AUTUMN GOLD: Began OK, ridden along to hold one-off position in          midfield. Kept on steadily to straight when gave ground     quickly, finishing tailed out. Unacceptable performance.
last_comments.KITAYA: Broke well, charged forward to race outside but a length    behind leader first turn and back stretch. Started to throw out distress signals around final turn and finished tailed  out. Unacceptable performance.
last_comments.DRAGON HARMONY: Bounced best, taken to front and travelled strongly,        setting good pace. Well clear entering straight but under   pressure passing 300m and weakened. Unacceptable            performance.
last_comments.EVERYONE'S CHOICE: Bumped start, recovered to race 2 wide, a length or so back in 2nd, same position on turn, peaked early in straight,    finished off evenly.
last_comments.THUNDER DASH: Began awkwardly and bumped, raced 4 lengths back in 9th,    there to turn, taken wide early in straight, made no        progress. (Lame left front leg next day.)
last_comments.SUPER JUNIOR: Settled worse than midfield about 7Ls behind the leader 2   wide with cover, one paced home.
last_comments.HASTA LA VISTA: Prominent, found nothing when asked and weakened badly      250M.
last_comments.TERRIFIC MASTER: Smart break, taken back to midfield 1 off with cover,       shifted 3 deep 700m, smooth progress wide into stretch, 1L  down & shaken up 300m, found little, emptied 150m.
last_comments.SWEET HOME: Broke ok, travelled wide & soon 4th, trapped 3-wide no      cover, niggled 550m, driven into stretch, found nil & faded tamely.
last_comments.GLORIOUS PARTNERS: Jumped fairly, eased, settled near rear 3 deep cover, under pressure 500m, one-paced in straight.
last_comments.HROVAT: Awkward start, bumped shortly after, settled rear 1 off,    racing erratically, asked for response 350m, gave little.
last_comments.EASY TOUCH: Ridden vigorously from gates, quickly to lead, 0.5L lead    900m, steady sectionals, ridden along 570m, grabbed 350m,   tried to fight on but effort short-lived.
last_comments.REGENCY HORSE: Settled in midfield, 5-1/4L behind 2 wide before eased down rounding turn. (Bled from both nostrils)
last_comments.HANG'S DECISION: Steadied soon after start, shifted to rail, then ridden to  hold position behind midfield. Left rail 500m, got split    250m finished strongly while hanging in to win close home.
last_comments.SUPREME PRIDE: Began only fairly, settled down 6-7Ls behind midfield along the inside, couldn't keep up 450M, soon weakened, eased.
last_comments.MR PELE: Began OK, outpaced, dropping to rear close to fence. Got    shuffled back approaching turn, took inside run in          straight, one-paced.
last_comments.MAMBO ROCK: No early pace, dropping to last pair in one-off position.   Dropped to last around home turn, taken wide in straight    and finished off nicely to be closest at finish.
last_comments.SUPER LIFELINE: Pushed forward early and stuck 3 wide, before pressing to   share the lead at 900m. Never responded when asked in the   straight and went to the line 1 paced.
last_comments.MY DARLING: Taken up early to be handily placed 5th/6th, but stuck 3    wide with limited cover. Dropped out quickly from the 300m, and eased to the line. Unacceptable performance. Jockey and trainer questioned.
last_comments.TEAM FORTUNE: Lifted front feet on jumping and was slow to begin. Taken   up to sit just forward of midfield, on the fence. Only fair in the straight and eased late. Vet-bled both nostrils.
last_comments.ISHVARA: Eased back from the wide draw to sit 3rd last, 3 wide with  limited cover. Never looked to press on in the straight,    and was eased to the line late.
last_comments.LUCKY BALL: Jumped with them, raced 3 lengths back on rail in 5th,      saved ground throughout, failed to close off in straight    and eased final 100M.
last_comments.BUDDY BUNDY: Ridden forward to take the fence and led by 1L at slow      sectionals, kept on strongly to the line until headed by    the winner over the final stride.
last_comments.PEARL WIN: Settled worse than midfield about 4Ls behind the leader 2   wide with cover, despite harmed by the slow sectionals,     swung widest and made some ground in straight.
last_comments.GRACEFUL KINGDOM: Fast break & prominent initially, settled 1 back 1 off,     niggled 700m, forced 3 wide 550m & shuffled back,           hard-ridden under pressure 400m, driven wide home turn,     struggled in run home.
last_comments.SKY MAN: Pushed to race just front of midfield, 3-1/4L off 2 wide,   kept on until flattened inside 150M.
last_comments.ENCOUNTER: Off OK, rolled forward but over-raced before settling       between horses behind midfield back stretch. Swung widest   into straight and picked up momentum gradually doing best   work final 100m. Lame right front leg.
last_comments.SO CAFFE: Began OK, no speed, dropping to rear taking first turn.     Fractured left front leg when clipped heels passing 900m    and pulled up.
last_comments.CHARITY JOY: Caught 3-wide no cover in mid-division, improved to 4th     passing 600M, finished off fairly from 350M, faded late     stages.
last_comments.DASHING SUPER: Jumped well, raced 2 wide in 5th, 7 lengths back on turn,   failed to close off in straight.
last_comments.DANEWIN EXPRESS: Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, still well  back on turn, made some headway in straight without         threatening the first few.
last_comments.DASHING FORTUNE: Jumped well from gate 1, positioned nicely in 4th, saved    ground throughout, 7 lengths back on turn, peaked early in  straight, emptied final 100M.
last_comments.LUCKY PLACE: Bumped shortly after start, positioned 2 wide in midfield,  8 lengths back on turn, made reasonable progress in         straight to make frame.
last_comments.FRESH AND FRESH: Jumped well, raced prominently, peaked on turn, emptied     early in straight.
last_comments.AMAZING KIDS: At back, travelled 4.5Ls behind the leader along the outer  fence, shifted to middle part of the track 400M, dashed     well to score by 1.5Ls.
last_comments.ADVENTURER: Hard ridden forward to share the lead, under pressure near  the course proper, weakened 300M.
last_comments.EXPECTATOR: Sprung out to early lead, ridden along to maintain          position, settled midfield on rail, ridden 500m, took time  to wind up, sprinted along rail, one-paced.
last_comments.TOP SCORE: Settled in midfield, 5L behind the lead 2 wide, did not     improve position and ran on same paced.
last_comments.DIAMOND KING: Pushed forward and raced outside the lead, sat 3/4L off,    kept on going to the line, just held onto 3rd.
last_comments.FIVE UP HIGH: Hard ridden to hold forward position before taking over     lead 1000m. Pulled 2L clear on straightening but soon       joined up front by another before finding a little extra to win in final strides.
last_comments.HAPPY WAY WINNER: Steadied soon after start and shifted across behind         runners, settling in last pair along rail. Came off fence   turning for home, shifted wide in straight and ran on       fairly.
last_comments.FABULOUS NOVEMBER: Slow to begin, ended up near the rear 4th from last, kept   on same pace turning in, never in contention.
last_comments.DESMIOS: Dropped back from wide draw, difficult to settle 1000M when pace slackened, 6Ls off the pace 400M, gave limited         response and never a threat to leaders.
last_comments.DRAGON DANCE: Began only fairly, improved to a midfield position along    the rail, couldn't keep up inside 350M and weakened         noticeably.
last_comments.AMAZING RACE: Began OK, no pace, settling along rail close to rear. Made  turn awkwardly, switched out in straight, found nothing.
last_comments.DILLY: Beaten for early pace, dropping to rear and taken in closer to fence. Last into straight, found nothing.
last_comments.TONYBOY: Settled around midfield, 1 off the fence. Off heels at the  top of the straight and bumped 350m. Never pushed out, and  eased to the line late.
last_comments.OPTIMISM: Gradually shuffled back towards the rear on rails, in       similar position entering home straight, produced good late impression closing stages.
last_comments.TREASURE AND GOLD: Broke well, travelled 3-wide in midfield far side,          commenced run rounding home bend, kept on same pace under   pressure.
last_comments.CHANS DELIGHT: Slowly away and wide throughout, soon recovered towards the rear of the field at the 1000 metre bend, gained closer to  midfield along back straight, gave ground approaching home  turn.
last_comments.LUCKY KINGDOM: Awkward away, midfield, trapped 3 wide throughout, out of   fuel 250M.
last_comments.PEARL HARBOUR: Raced 4-5 wide and hung out badly throughout, never a       factor.
last_comments.WIN IT: Taken back from wide gate, trapped 3 wide no cover back of  midfield, bustled forward a spot 850m but unable to go on,  wide into stretch, plodded on tamely.
last_comments.IMPERIAL GALLANTRY: Broke inwards at start, settled just beyond midfield 1 off, shifted 3 deep 1000m, under vigorous drive 650m, no         response.
last_comments.BURST AWAY: In front of midfield, 2-1/4L off the lead but 3 wide and    without cover, in touch until checked at 100M, run ended    thereafter.
last_comments.WONDERFUL FIGHTER: Pushed forward and raced outside the lead, sat 1L off, in   touch until final 50M when outgunned, kept on for 4th.
last_comments.FLAME HERO: Crowded out start, dropped to rear but kept away from       fence. Shaken up 700m when tempo increased but unable match speed, dropping to last. Taken to centre field on           straightening and boxed on one-paced. Lame left front leg.
last_comments.SUPER FLUKE: Settled down 3-wide towards the rear, 6Ls off the pace      halfway, never near to challenge, no extra and eased 200M.
last_comments.KERKENI: Slowly away, settled in last few, last and wide into        straight, kept on steadily down the centre of the straight.
last_comments.FRANCE VALOUR: Pressed forward from a wide gate, raced wide prominently in 4th or 3rd within 3L of pace, dropped out from approaching  home turn. (Bled)
last_comments.GLAMOROUS RYDER: Settled wide in midfield in 6th, in similar position        turning in, found nothing in the run home.
last_comments.MAGIC STAR: Chased leader to straight, soon weakened under pressure.
last_comments.ROYAL SPIRIT: Broke down and was retired out of the race near 1200M.      (Lame left front fetlock)
last_comments.HARMONY PARTNERS: Pressed forward to park outside the leader at fast tempo,   weakened soon after straightening.
last_comments.PRECIOUS GEM: Raced midfield, 4Ls behind the leader 3 wide with cover,    despite the fast tempo, never ran on.
last_comments.THUNDERSTROKE: Prominent, harmed by the fast sectionals, dropped off       rounding the Home Turn, tailed out.
last_comments.INFINITY ENDEAVOUR: Good start, pushed to race handy, outpaced slightly,        settled fore of midfield 1 off, niggled at times            throughout, pulled centre track in straight, sprinted to    lead 150m but gave out late.
last_comments.STAR OF PATCH: Eased from wide draw, nudged along 800m, last of main pack  on rail, pulled 1 off into straight, sprinted strongly 400m between runners, nifty turn of foot to score.
last_comments.JOYFUL TRINITY: Reserved near the rear 3-4Ls off the pace, challenged up    the inside but raced in restricted room 300M, well held     under top weight over final stages.
last_comments.SUN JEWELLERY: Held up 5th of 7,  taken wide 500M, gave brief response     turning in, couldn't go on mid-straight, eased 150M.        (Jockey : action deteriorated passing 300M / Mucus)
last_comments.BEAUTY FLAME: Took early lead, sat behind leader passing 1000M, in touch  top of straight, gave chase hard but unable to sprint       quickly enough over final 200M. (Lame RF leg)
last_comments.BLIZZARD: Held up last of 7 about 4Ls off the pace, quickened up      strongly passing 350M, led near 200M and powered away for a solid win.
last_comments.RAZOR QUEST: Jumped OK, eased and taken to fence, settling behind        midfield. Left fence turning for home, caught in traffic    top of straight, blocked 200m, forced through gap between   horses 50m to win close home.
last_comments.UNICRON JEWELLERY: Took a few strides to find feet then rolled forward along   fence to snatch box seat on settling. Left flat-footed top  of straight, picked up momentum passing 200m but reluctant  to improve in restricted space final 100m.
last_comments.EL SHERIF: Settled midfield, 1 off the fence. Looked to run on from    300m, but stalled and went to the line 1 paced.
last_comments.PRINCIPAL: Settled midfield, 3 wide with limited cover. Gave nothing   early in the straight, and was eased out a long way from    home. Unacceptable performance.
last_comments.SECRET COMMAND: Began awkwardly and always near the tail, offered very      little on the run home, never in the picture.
last_comments.LUCKY BOLE: Jumped awkwardly and given reminders, picked up to forward  of midfield turning into back straight, came under pressure in midfield rounding home bend, weakened in home straight.  (Bled)
last_comments.LOVELY DELOVELY: Hard ridden forward, ran on until 250M emptied.
last_comments.FRUITFUL LIFE: Away well, under riding early, settled ahead of midfield 1  off, lost ground steadily throughout, awkwardly placed      700m, very weak in straight.
last_comments.GLACIER BLUE: Raced at the tail throughout, found nothing in the straight.
last_comments.ACCEPTED: Began awkwardly from gate 10, raced 3 lengths or so back on the stands rail, made no impression final 400M.
last_comments.FOREVER RED: Moderately away, raced prominently near to the stands side, peaked near 400M, weakened gradually thereafter.
last_comments.TOWERING STORM: Taken back from gate 8, raced at tail, bumped near 900M and eased shortly thereafter. (Lame left front.) (See Racing    Incidents.)
last_comments.GO SANDY GO: Taken back from gate 9, raced at tail, bumped near 900M,    still well back on turn, failed to close off in straight.
last_comments.PROPEL REPEL: Pushed early, behind midfield 2 wide, benefited by the fast pace, lack room 300M, made minor ground, hampered 100M.
last_comments.SAFARI MAGIC: Sent forward from a wide gate to park outside the leader,   not suited by the fast sectionals, weakened over the last   furlong.
last_comments.INNOVATIVE WINNER: Pushed to occupy the box seat, weakened badly over the last furlong, tailed out.
last_comments.OH SO EASY: Steady start, raced last pair on rail, to last 880m &       niggled, driven into stretch, found nil.
last_comments.WORLD CITY: Smart start, raced handy 3 wide with cover until slotted 1  off 1 back 750m, shifted out to challenge turning in,       narrow lead  250m, headed 180m & tapered.
last_comments.JING JING WIN: Jumped well, in front briefly before ceded advantage to     settle just off the pace coming out of back straight,       briefly baulked early in home straight, failed to peg back  the winner.
last_comments.HO HO FEEL: Eased back, 2 wide, harmed by the slow tempo, unleashed     strong finishing efforts 300M.
last_comments.HIGHLAND REEL: Jumped well, allowed to stride forward at own pace before   taking clear lead 1850m. Put under pressure 1450m but edged ahead again. Kicked 3L clear 300m to look winner but run    down in the shadows of the post.
last_comments.SILVERWAVE: Began well, pushed forward along rail, settling 3L from     leader 1600m. Kept on steadily to 300m when ran out of      stamina and faded.
last_comments.BIG ORANGE: Began well, pushed forward but wide 3L from leader. Allowed to roll forward from 1600m to race outside leader 1450m.    Kept on steadily to 800m when came under pressure and gave  ground gradually.
last_comments.SATONO CROWN: Broke well, allowed to find feet and gradually taken to     fence towards the rear and shut off. Shaken up passing      900m, steadied 700m, got clear run 300m, ran on strongly to win close home.
last_comments.HELENE HAPPY STAR: Pressed forward but wide to sit 2L behind leader at first   turn and then kept tabs until 400m when gave ground quickly finished tailed out. Unacceptable performance.
last_comments.GARLINGARI: Hampered shortly after start but ridden to make up ground,  settling behind midfield. Lost position turning for home    but boxed on one-paced in straight. Lame right front leg.
last_comments.ONE FOOT IN HEAVEN: Began only fairly, then checked, dropping to rear but kept  away from fence. Shaken up passing 1150m, got inside run in straight, ran on steadily for distant third.
last_comments.QUECHUA: Jumped fairly, restrained and shifted across behind runners settling at rear. Got shuffled back turning for home and    one-paced in straight.
last_comments.BENZINI: Shifted across behind runners from wide draw, settling at   rear. Asked to take closer order passing 1200m, got inside  run in straight but only one-paced.
last_comments.NUOVO RECORD: Ridden early but unable handle pace and eased back, racing  3-deep at the rear. Shuffled back to last passing 1150m,    picked up speed entering straight and ran on nicely between horses.
last_comments.SMART LAYER: Pressed forward from an outside draw to race in midfield    but without cover. Put under pressure turning for home but  only one-paced.
last_comments.AEROVELOCITY: Broke well but eased off pace, settling between horses 2L   from leader. Switch out top of straight to make run,        gradually increased speed to hit the front 100m, then held  off determined challenge.
last_comments.LUCKY BUBBLES: Jumped well but hampered shortly after, dropping to behind  midfield. Got close to heels around turn, switched out 380m for clear run, finished strongly to just miss.
last_comments.BIG ARTHUR: Pressed forward from an outside draw, racing wide without   cover in midfield. Covered extra ground turn, wide into     straight, found little under pressure final 200m. Had small cut inside right front fetlock.
last_comments.REBEL DANE: Hard ridden to obtain forward position, racing 3-wide 2L    from leader into turn. Still in contention to 200m when     condition gave out and faded.
last_comments.SIGNS OF BLESSING: Shifted across behind runners from wide draw and last on    settling. Trailed field to straight, taken to centre track  and finished off nicely.
last_comments.RED FALX: Ridden along from an outside draw but didn't muster and     kept wide at the rear. Kept wide in straight but limited    response when asked.
last_comments.GROWL: Jumped well, pressed forward but wide, gradually dropping   back towards rear. Shuffled back to last entering straight  and plodded home.
last_comments.TAKEDOWN: Crowded and unbalanced shortly after start, settling        between horses ahead of midfield. Kept on steadily in       straight under hard riding without looking dangerous.
last_comments.SUPER JOCKEY: Quickly away, pressed forward to race outside leader.       Stayed in contention to 200m when ran out of steam and      faded.
last_comments.MR BOGART: Rolled forward and took up box-seat, sat 1-1/2L behind the  lead, battled on nicely to the line.
last_comments.ABLE FRIEND: Jumped with field but restrained looking for cover at       settling at the rear in one-off position. Taken to centre   track on straightening and ran on steadily.
last_comments.LOGOTYPE: Slow into stride then vigorously ridden to make up ground,  grabbing box seat 2L from leader at turn. Held for run top  of straight, got clear 200m, finished off nicely.
last_comments.GIANT TREASURE: Slow into stride, dropping to last, then shifted across     behind running to fence. Made up some ground around turn    but found little in straight under hard riding.
last_comments.NEOREALISM: Broke well, pressed forward 3-wide to race outside          hindquarters of leader on turning. Rolled forward to hit    front 200m but then ran out of stamina and faded.
last_comments.PACKING PINS: Began OK, pressed forward to hold rail, settling 4L from    leader. Under pressure soon after straightening and gave    ground steadily from 200m.
last_comments.COUGAR MOUNTAIN: Broke well, allowed to stride at own pace while edging      towards rail behind midfield. Took inside run in straight   but only one-paced.
