last_comments.AMERICAN FAME: Began fairly, no early pace and settled at rear, ran home   steadily in straight.
last_comments.BRAVE BROTHER: Failed to muster despite hard ridden along, travelled 4.5Ls behind the leader on the fence, made ground steadily.
last_comments.SNITZEL KID: Slow to muster despite ridden along, travelled 4.5Ls behind the leader 2-3 wide with cover, weakened rounding the Home  Turn.
last_comments.SHADOWFAXE: Smart start widest, pace to edge lead 3 deep 960m, headed   620m, ridden 450m but emptied 300m, eased down.
last_comments.FAST MARVEL: Taken behind from wide gate, raced at tail on rail,         progress on turn, driven into stretch & plugged on dourly   for some headway.
last_comments.FUN 'N' GAMES: Hard ridden forward, just off the leader 2 wide, harmed by  the fast pace, no turn of foot in straight.
last_comments.JOLLY VICTOR: Settled down near the rear early stages, raced keenly in    midfield down back straight, stayed on well to be closest   on the line.
last_comments.ORIENTAL PROSPER: Pressed forward, racing wide without cover about 1L behind  leader. Lay out around turn but remained in contention      until weakening final 200m.
last_comments.HOLY MAC: Slow to begin, raced keenly near 1400m, under pressure home turn before weakening in straight.
last_comments.FORTUNE BRAVO: Jumped well and settled behind leaders, stoked up to        challenge home turn, tried hard in straight but could not   run down leader.
last_comments.SENSIBLE CHOICE: Jumped awkwardly, niggled along throughout, never           responded.
last_comments.CONFUCIUS ELITE: Speed to lead under drive, headed 1130m, sat 1 back from    820m, shifted 1 off & driven 350m, plugged on evenly.
last_comments.KING OF REASON: Broke well but soon outpaced, raced rail near rear, crowded & not clear run turning in, shaken up 300m, stayed on for   minor inroads.
last_comments.COUP D'ETAT: Eased to sit in front of midfield, 4Ls off the leader on    the rails, suited by the fast pace, held up 4-2, closed off well when  clear.
last_comments.SKIP COURT: Very slow away, never a factor.
last_comments.SUN PINS: Began OK, settling three-back, one-off back stretch. Urged  forward between horses around turn but blocked for run in   straight until 200m. Finished off nicely.
last_comments.JUST WONDERFUL: Began well but unable find cover and raced wide back        stretch. Lost position around turn, and tired soon after    entering straight.
last_comments.BAAB AL NASR: Shifted across behind runners from wide draw, settling at   rear close to fence. Improved position around turn, shifted in abruptly 400m to get run and finished off nicely. Rider  dropped rein 200m.
last_comments.GOLDEN ADDICTION: Up with early pace, restrained to 6th place middle stages,  responded well leaving the bend to go 2nd 150M, proved no   match with winner, one paced final stages and lost 2nd near line.
last_comments.SIGHT BELIEVER: Got off nicely, racing close to outer fence 3L from leader. Raced in restricted room 700m but remained in contention    till final 200m when tired slightly.
last_comments.WINNING TIME: Began fairly, then crowded and lost ground, settling last.  Lost contact with the field 400m and never competitive.
last_comments.TAKE TO THE LIMIT: Taken back early to sit towards the rear of the field, 1    off the fence. Never fully ridden out in the straight, and  found to be lame in the off fore leg.
last_comments.SUNNY YING: Pushed forward from the jump to sit in a handy position, 1  off the fence. Prominently placed early in the straight,    but had a tendency to lay in, peaked at the 200m and faded  back.
last_comments.NAMJONG BLOSSOMS: Bumped start, recovered to race prominently, unbalanced     near 450M, folded up quickly after straightening, finished  tailed out.
last_comments.LUCKY FOLLOW ME: Began awkwardly and settled at rear, one paced on straight.
last_comments.JUST ACE: Settled on pace, raced keenly and steadied passing 1000m,   under pressure home turn and the weakened in straight.
last_comments.MANIPULATION: Inconvenienced at start, settled midfield, impeded near     300m but had every chance thereafter.
last_comments.SOLAR DRAGON: Jumped well, got head up when steadied at 1100m,            inconvenienced at 1000m, traveled nicely near 600m, ridden  along to challenge home turn, brief chance at 300m but      weakened final 150m.
last_comments.EVERYONE'S FORTUNE: Dropped back at break, raced at rear throughout, never a    factor.
last_comments.MOBILE KING: Slow start & rousted to race fore of midfield on rail,      driven turning in, shifted 1 off, stayed on dourly to wire.
last_comments.ALL MY BENEFIT: Broke well, raced 1 back on rail, under pump 560m,          struggled in tepid run home.
last_comments.EN CIVIL: Hard ridden to take rail and led by 0.5L, clocked fast      sectionals, reduced quickly 300M.
last_comments.ALWAYS SOMETHING: At rear, 7Ls off the leader 2-3 wide, benefited by the fast pace, progressed steadily 300M.
last_comments.WINNING APEX: Hard ridden early, 4Ls off the leader 2 wide, benefited by  the fast tempo, flattened in straight.
last_comments.NAVEL ORANGE: Began fairly, taken in but kept away from fence, settling   behind midfield in one-off position. Switched three-wide    around final turn to make challenge but only one-paced in   straight.
last_comments.OCEAN POWER: Crowded out and bumped start, ridden but failed to muster,  settling in midfield. Lost position back stretch when       others moved forward and found little in straight when      asked.
last_comments.BANGALORE: Bounded out of the gates, and sat at the rear of the field. Came widest from the 300m, but delivered nothing, and only  beat one home.
last_comments.NAUGHTY BABY: Crowded on jumping, and initially at the rear of the field  on the fence. Worked forward in early/mid stages to sit     midfield. Worked forward steadily from the turn, but never  a threat, and peaked 100m.
last_comments.ROCKET FLY: Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail throughout,  only passed a few tired runners in straight, never a threat.
last_comments.COSTA DEL SOL: Ridden along to hold 4th spot within 2L of pace, became     3-wide in 6th around home bend, failed to quicken under     pressure after straightening.
last_comments.POSITIVE ENERGY: Awkward start losing ground, trailed the field to straight, fought on steadily past well beaten horses.
last_comments.SING SING SING: Jumped well and sent forward, niggle at near 700m, hung in  badly and gave ground quickly, eased down final 150m.
last_comments.SUNSHINE KID: Broke well & prominent until settled 1 back on rail,        bustled a touch 850m, ridden turning in, found nil & faded  right out.
last_comments.MONEY CAFE: Smart break, raced 4th 1 off with cover, driven to lead     360m, all out & headed 280m, tapered thereafter.
last_comments.SILVER MISSION: Speed to lead but soon headed & sat rail in 3rd , shifted 1 off 420m but not clear run, shuffled back & lost several    lengths, found nil thereafter.
last_comments.BRILLANTE: Settled just off the lead, reduced 200M.
last_comments.FAY DEEP: Hard ridden to keep up at rear, 6Ls off the leaders, no     progress.
last_comments.WINDICATOR STAR: Crowded out at start, dropping to rear but away from fence. Clear last around turn, taken wide in straight and ran on   fairly.
last_comments.REGENCY HO HO: In midfield early stages, shuffled back to 3rd last         approaching home turn, held up for clear running early      straight, failed to respond when ridden to chase leaders.   (Muco)
last_comments.FIONN'S TREASURE: Just off the pace tracking along the 2-path, stayed on      mildly to go 3rd near the line.
last_comments.ELECTRONIC GOSPEL: Travelled wide just better than midfield early stages,      obtained cover in home straight the first time but          difficult to settle to slow pace at times, slightly worse   when pace quickened far side, found nothing in the run home.
last_comments.SUPER HORSE: Jumped fairly to be midfield early, gradually dropped back  far side to reach tail-end over 500 metres out, no further  impression.
last_comments.GLOBAL FAME: Settled worse than midfield, pushed along to improve near   500m, kept to rail in straight and finished off one paced.
last_comments.P J HALL: Bumped at start, settled on pace, under pressure home turn, steadied at 100m when weakening out of it.
last_comments.GIDEON: Started OK, raced rail midfield, broke down & fell 850m.
last_comments.MY NAME IS BOND: Jumped well, pressed forward to hold second spot, 1L from   leader. Looked a chance top of straight but ran out of      stamina 200m and weakened. Lame right front leg.
last_comments.GOOD FRIENDS MAGIC: Travelled keenly in midfield 3-wide, slightly wider turning in, found nothing in straight.
last_comments.BLACK STAR: Settled in midfield one off the rails, soon faded after     straightening.
last_comments.TRIUMPHANT WAY: Towards the rear, one-paced in straight.
last_comments.RISING FAST: Raced midfield, travelled 4Ls behind the leader 2 wide with cover, eased down soon after straightening.
last_comments.ULTIMATE WINNERS: At rear throughout, never looked competitive.
last_comments.SUMARAND DRAGON: Broke ok to race on inner behind midfield, shaken up 350m,  outpaced in run home.
last_comments.INCREDIBLE ACT: Tardy start, raced rail midfield, advanced a spot 650m,     bustled 500m & shifted out, faded in run home.
last_comments.FOREVER GENKI: Away with them, raced 4 lengths or so back on rail at rear, last turning in, finished off one-paced.
last_comments.GOOD SMILE: Began well, raced 3 wide with no cover, a length behind the leader, same margin back on turn, weakened gradually in     straight.
last_comments.MAZANDARAN: Ridden to hold forward position, settling one-back,         one-off. Niggled at around home turn to hold position, a    little wide into straight, boxed on gamely.
last_comments.COOL BEAN: Bumped start, ridden to get forward position but found a    few others faster and forced to race wide without cover at  midfield. Put under pressure 300m but found nothing and     faded.
last_comments.EYE ON YOU: Midfield, 4Ls off the leader, trapped 3 wide throughout,    harmed by the slow pace, never improved.
last_comments.HAWTHORNE: Very awkward away, hard ridden to keep up in midfield, 4Ls  off the leader on the rails, not suited by the slow pace,   no turn of foot.
last_comments.SUPER DRAGON: Jumped only fairly.  From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
last_comments.LAUDABLE VIRTUE: Crowded at start and settled towards rear, held up early    part of straight, commenced to make ground passing 300m,    crowded at 250m, finished off nicely.
last_comments.YOUNG HAPPY: Slow to begin and crowded shortly after, settle at rear,    commenced to improve passing 500m, bumped and unbalanced    when laying in near 250m.
last_comments.TRACKER: Taken back from a wide gate, travelled 6.5Ls behind the     leader 2 wide with cover, not suited by the slow tempo,     never ran on.
last_comments.SURE CHAMP: Began well, making use of good draw to settle three-back,   one-off. Travelled well to turn when put under pressure     without responding. Not tested latter stages of race.       Jockey reported not comfortable in action.
last_comments.ELECTRONIC FORTUNE: Pressed forward, racing three-wide without cover outside    leading pair to turn. Lost position entering straight and   weakened gradually.
last_comments.ISLAND GARDEN: Restrained, shifted across behind horses from wide draw and last on settling. Never competitive. Found to have          substantial blood in trachea.
last_comments.REAL SPECIALIST: Never far off 2.5Ls behind leader in a slowly run race,     sprinted home well from 350M, chased winner all the way to  line, held by diminishing neck.
last_comments.MI SAVVY: Jumped well, positioned nicely in 2nd, same position on     turn, kept on well in straight to get 2nd, no threat to the winner.
last_comments.NO TIES: Taken back from wide gate at start, hard ridden near 500m,  one paced in straight.
last_comments.TWIN TURBO: Hard ridden from start but slow to muster and trapped wide  without cover in midfield around first turn. Allowed to     stride forward from 1000m to race outside lead from 800m to straight before tiring gradually.
last_comments.RIYADH: Began fairly but failed to stretch out and soon last.       Trailed field thereafter.
last_comments.BOTH SURE: Behind midfield, 5Ls off the leaders on the rails, harmed   by the slow pace, little dash 100M.
last_comments.PRINCE OF SUNSHINE: Jumped well and settled behind leader, unable to quicken on straightening and battled to the line.
last_comments.SECRET IDENTITY: Jumped awkwardly and ridden along to settle on speed, under pressure from 800m and weakened out of it soon after.
last_comments.BEYOND FANTASY: Settled worse than midfield about 6Ls behind the leader on  the fence, never a factor, collapsed after the race.
last_comments.GIGGLES FOREVER: In front of midfield, 3.5Ls off the good pace on the rails, flattened 250M, on heels 200M.
last_comments.JUN JU: Eased back, 10Ls off the good pace along the fence, lack    room 250M, no turn of foot.
last_comments.DOUBLE GLORY: Fractious in stalls, jumped awkwardly and lost significant  amount of ground, recovered along the fence to race within  range of the leaders to top of the straight before fading   away 250M.
last_comments.RED COURAGE: Settled on pace, unable to improve home turn, battled to    line one paced.
last_comments.BUNKER SHOT: Broke ok, bustled to settle 1 back on rail, shaken up       turning in but in pocket & checked 230m, switched 1 off,    kept on for 3rd but always held.
last_comments.TOMODACHI: Sharp start, caught 4 wide no cover 2L back, rolled on to   within 1L 500m, found nil in run home.
last_comments.SICHUAN EXEC: Shaken up early to take up a forward position,  raced       keenly, in 4th making the turn for home, failed to find     extra when placed under pressure.
last_comments.TOPSPIN KING: Jumped only fairly.  M L Yeung was warned in respect to using his whip on a horse which was not responding to his riding on one occasion near the 100 Metres.
last_comments.ALWAYS MY FOLKS: Leaving the 300  Metres improved into a narrow run between COMET RADIANCE and ZETA HEDGE which was commencing to give ground.  As a result ALWAYS MY FOLKS had difficulty obtaining clear running between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
last_comments.BEAUTY GEMINI: A Badel stated that his mount was able to lead the event but failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight and was disappointing. He added that his mount may not have been suited by the early stages being run slightly inside of standard time. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
last_comments.JOLLY COMPANION: Approaching the 300 Metres made contact with GIMME FIVE due to both runners shifting ground.  Z Purton stated that after obtaining a position outside the lead his mount failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight but could offer no excuse for the horse’s disappointing performance.  Trainer K L Man advised that the horse had pleased him leading into the race and he had instructed Jockey Purton to go forward from its wide barrier.  He added the only explanation he could offer for the horse’s disappointing performance was that too much use had to be made of the horse in the early stages to go forward.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of JOLLY COMPANION was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, JOLLY COMPANION will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
last_comments.SWEET BRIAR: On jumping became unbalanced when bumped by DIRIYA which shifted in.  C L Chau reported that his mount would be advantaged by being stepped up in distance for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
last_comments.DIRIYA: B Avdulla reported that the instructions were to obtain a position with cover.  He said when his mount commenced well it showed superior pace and led without being pressured to do so.  He added DIRIYA failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight and raced disappointingly.  Trainer C H Yip advised that he had not expected the horse to lead and, in his opinion, DIRIYA travelled too strongly in front which resulted in it being left without a finishing effort in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
last_comments.RUNJEET: A Badel advised that the instructions were to go forward.  He said RUNJEET was slow to begin and as a result settled back in the field.  He added RUNJEET failed to travel throughout the race and did not run on when placed under pressure in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
last_comments.SMART CITY: Was a late withdrawal acting on veterinary advice after sustaining multiple lacerations to the left hip, right front and left hind pasterns whilst being transported to the course.  Before being allowed to race again, SMART CITY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
last_comments.SPICY SPANGLE: Bumped shortly after the start.  Apprentice P N Wong reported that her instructions were to go forward but she was obliged to make some use of the horse in the early stages to comply with those instructions.  She added as a result SPICY SPANGLE did not finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
last_comments.SOLAR RIVER: Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  Between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of COMET RADIANCE.  Noted to have blood in the mouth after the race.
last_comments.TRUE BROTHERS: Near the 900 Metres was hampered when taken wider by GHORGAN.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.  Before being allowed to race again, TRUE BROTHERS will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
last_comments.HOLMES A COURT: Leaving the 900 Metres was hampered when bumped by LUCKY DOCTOR which shifted out.  Near the 600 Metres became badly unbalanced when bumped heavily by LUCKY DOCTOR which shifted out abruptly.  B Avdulla reported that after being bumped heavily near the 600 Metres his mount lost momentum from that point and failed to finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  HOLMES A COURT, which weakened in the Home Straight, will be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.
last_comments.KANSAS: Near the 700 Metres was taken wider by KING’S ARROW which improved to the outside of PEJIBAYE.  KANSAS then raced wide and without cover thereafter.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, KANSAS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
last_comments.CALIFORNIA BAY: Jumped awkwardly and shortly after the start made contact with PRIVATE WEALTH. Near the 800 Metres shifted out when being steadied to avoid PRIVATE WEALTH. In the middle stages raced keenly.
last_comments.LEGEND STAR: Near the 800 Metres was steadied when crowded between NEW POWER and CALIFORNIA BAY which shifted out when being steadied to avoid PRIVATE WEALTH. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
last_comments.TACTICAL COMMAND: Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between I AM BACK and GLORIOUS DYNASTY which was taken in by LIGHTNESS OF BEING.  Over the final 50 Metres could not be ridden out to the finish of the event when it improved between GLORIOUS DYNASTY and LOVING VIBES which was giving ground.
last_comments.NOISY BOY: C L Chau stated that he was instructed to endeavour to obtain a position with cover.  He said when caught wide in the early stages and when the race was being run outside of standard time he allowed NOISY BOY to stride forward to attempt to avoid racing wide and without cover.  He added when the pace of the event quickened he was obliged to remain racing wide and without cover for the remainder of the event.  Trainer C H Yip confirmed the instructions were to  ride NOISY BOY with cover as the horse did not finish its race off when ridden forward to lead at its previous race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
last_comments.JUMBO STEPS: Prior to the running of the event Trainer P C Ng confirmed that from a wide barrier he had instructed for the horse to be ridden in a conservative manner in the early stages to offset the wide barrier. From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages. Held up for clear running making the Home Turn.
last_comments.SERANGOON: Slow to begin.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  The performance of SERANGOON was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SERANGOON will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
last_comments.FLUORESCENCE: E C W Wong stated that his mount failed to travel throughout the event and did not respond to his riding in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of FLUORESCENCE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FLUORESCENCE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
last_comments.ROMANTIC FANTASY: Shifted in at the start and made contact with FAST SPEED.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
last_comments.CAN'T GO WONG: Shifted in on jumping and made contact with TO INFINITY.
last_comments.STAR BROSE: Raced keenly in the early stages and near the 1000 Metres was steadied to avoid VIEW ALL THINGS.  Sent for sampling post-race.
last_comments.SMILING ONE: In the early stages raced keenly and for some distance near the 1500 Metres was steadied to avoid GOOD LUCK WIN.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
last_comments.OCEAN IMPACT: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 1450 Metres became unbalanced when bumped by SPLENDID FORCE which shifted in.  Held up between the 500 Metres and the 300 Metres.  Near the 150 Metres became unbalanced when crowded between SPLENDID FORCE and COOL BLUE (S Osborne) which shifted out when held up behind SETANTA.  S Osborne was advised to exercise more care.  L Hewitson stated that his instructions were to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.  Trainer D J Whyte stated that the intention was to hold a midfield position but the horse settled further back in the field than intended.  He added he issued those instructions as OCEAN IMPACT has run its best races when being ridden conservatively in the early stages.
last_comments.FRIENDS OF SHAJING: Near the 700 Metres was eased to avoid CROSSBORDERDUDE (A Atzeni) which shifted in when not sufficiently clear.  A Atzeni was advised to exercise more care.  C L Chau reported that his mount did not travel well during the event.  He added in the Home Straight FRIENDS OF SHAJING did not respond to his riding and over the final 100 Metres he had some concern with its action.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, FRIENDS OF SHAJING will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
last_comments.LIVE WIRE: Z Purton stated that his mount showed sufficient pace to lead the event as expected.  He said when asked for an effort in the Home Straight LIVE WIRE did not respond to his riding and near the 150 Metres when he was concerned there was something amiss he did not fully test the horse to the finish of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, LIVE WIRE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.
last_comments.VICTOR THE RAPID: Was withdrawn at the Start by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice after it was found to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, VICTOR THE RAPID will be subjected to an official veterinary examination which must include additional diagnostic assessments.
last_comments.A TIME FOR US: After travelling a short distance was crowded.
last_comments.JOLLY BONUS: Jumped only fairly. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
last_comments.EVERSTAR: Shortly after the start was checked when crowded between ARMOUR WAR EAGLE and VIEW OF COSMOS which shifted out.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
last_comments.LIGHTNESS OF BEING: Approaching the 100 Metres was eased to avoid TOURBILLON GOLFER which shifted out after making slight contact with THUNDER ACTION.  Y L Chung could offer no explanation for the horse failing to run on in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
last_comments.KWAI CHUNG TALENTS: KWAI CHUNG TALENTS, which was fractious in the starting gates, jumped only fairly.
last_comments.SAME TO YOU: Trainer M Newnham confirmed that from a wide barrier he instructed for the horse to be ridden in a conservative manner in the early stages with the expected good early pace.  Sent for sampling post-race.
last_comments.GRATIFIDE: R Kingscote reported that he was instructed to go forward.  He said after obtaining a position outside the lead GRATIFIDE came under pressure on the Home Turn before giving ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, GRATIFIDE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
last_comments.JUICY DRAGON: Near the 700 Metres was steadied to avoid HAYDAY which shifted out making the turn.
last_comments.ARMOUR WAR EAGLE: Shortly after the start was checked when crowded between BETTER AND BETTER and EVERSTAR which was taken out by VIEW OF COSMOS.
last_comments.LUCKY MCQUEEN: Blundered on jumping, shifted out and made contact with NEW POWER. From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages. Sent for sampling post-race.
last_comments.ELEGANT LIFE: Raced keenly in the middle stages.  Sent for sampling post-race.
last_comments.YOUNG ARROW: On jumping made contact with VIVA PROSPERAR due to both runners shifting ground. Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
last_comments.WINNING MONEY: Shifted out at the start and made contact with BRILLIANT TURN.  Sent for sampling post-race.
last_comments.GROUPER: E C W Wong stated that his mount jumped awkwardly and as a result lost ground at the start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
last_comments.STAR OF HEARTS: Jumped only fairly.  Near the 500 Metres was steadied when positioned tight to the inside of YOUNG ARROW.
last_comments.FORZA LEADER: For a short distance approaching the 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.
last_comments.GOLDEN FRIENDSHIP: Near the 950 Metres shifted out and made contact with RUNJEET.
last_comments.POPE CODY: From the 900 Metres commenced a forward move and was obliged to race wide and without cover thereafter. Sent for sampling post-race.
last_comments.ROMANTIC GLADIATOR: E C W Wong stated that his mount failed to travel throughout the event and did not respond to his riding in the Home Straight but he could offer no excuse for the performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
last_comments.HIGHLAND RAHY: Raced wide and without cover until near the 750 Metres.  L Hewitson stated that the intention was to go forward and attempt to lead.  He said HIGHLAND RAHY jumped only fairly and despite being ridden along in the early stages did not show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position.
last_comments.CALL ME TOPSEED: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
last_comments.EMBRACES: When questioned regarding his riding making the Home Turn and in the early stages of the Home Straight and as to whether there was an opportunity to follow POPE CODY, C L Chau stated that after being positioned to the outside of POPE CODY his intention was to follow I CAN and FORZA TORO into the event.  He said when FORZA TORO did not improve as he had expected this resulted in EMBRACES being held up for clear running until near the 250 Metres.  He added whilst an opportunity presented to follow POPE CODY his instructions were to come to the outside and this was the main reason why he did not elect to follow POPE CODY.  Trainer W K Mo confirmed the instructions were to make a run to the outside in the Home Straight.
last_comments.SUPER UNICORN: Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between TANG HEART and CHIU CHOW SPIRIT.  Between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres was held up for clear running.  Passing the 200 Metres endeavoured to improve into a tight run between GULU GOGO and ANOTHER ZONDA which was giving ground.  When GULU GOGO shifted out slightly SUPER UNICORN was steadied when disappointed for clear running.
last_comments.ALL ROUND WINNER: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
last_comments.HYMNBOOK: In the early stages raced keenly and approaching the 1400 Metres was steadied to avoid FLYING FORTUNE for some distance. Near the 1000 Metres shifted out and made contact with RISING PHOENIX. H Bentley advised that the horse raced too keenly during the race and as a result was unable to finish the race off in the Home Straight. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea. Before being allowed to race again, HYMNBOOK will be subjected to an official veterinary examination. Sent for sampling post-race.
last_comments.VIVA GRACIOUSNESS: Apprentice P N Wong pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference approaching the 1400 Metres (see MISSION GIANT).  Apprentice Wong could offer no excuse for her mount’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
last_comments.REFUSETOBEENGLISH: Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start was checked to avoid WELL ENOUGH.  Near the 400 Metres was steadied to avoid JUMBO STEPS.
last_comments.LOVE TOGETHER: Shortly after the start made contact with SIGHT HERMOSO.  After travelling a short distance made contact with GLOWING PRAISES due to both runners shifting ground. Sent for sampling post-race.
last_comments.CASA OF HONOR: Jumped only fairly.  M F Poon reported that his mount gave ground over the final 200 Metres but could offer no explanation for the disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

last_comments.DRAGON FOUR SEAS: Knuckled over at the start. last_comments.LE ZONDA: Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  C L Chau (SPEED DRAGON) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 100 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when insufficiently clear of LE ZONDA, resulting in LE ZONDA losing its rightful running and having to be steadied and also LE ZONDA then shifting in across the running of CALIFORNIATOTALITY which was steadied.  C L Chau was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 29 November 2026 and to expire on Thursday, 3 December 2026 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, Jockey Chau was fined $60,000.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his poor race riding record.
last_comments.HUGE WAVE: Was withdrawn at the Start by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice after it was found to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, HUGE WAVE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

last_comments.TOP DRAGON: Near the 700 Metres was steadied when awkwardly positioned to the inside of MIGHTY STEED.  The Stewards inquired into the reasons for TOP DRAGON being severely checked between PRAY FOR JUSTICE (K Teetan) and LUCKY SAM GOR (C L Chau) passing the winning post.  K Teetan was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the winning post he allowed his mount to shift out, contributing to TOP DRAGON being severely checked between PRAY FOR JUSTICE and LUCKY SAM GOR.  In all the circumstances K Teetan was issued with a severe reprimand and advised that in similar circumstances he would be expected to make a greater effort than what he did on this occasion to prevent his mounts from shifting ground.  C L Chau was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the winning post he allowed his mount to shift in when insufficiently clear of TOP DRAGON, contributing to TOP DRAGON being severely checked between LUCKY SAM GOR and PRAY FOR JUSTICE.  In issuing Jockey Chau with a severe reprimand the Stewards were mindful that LUCKY SAM GOR did shift in quickly which provided Jockey Chau with limited opportunity to straighten his mount.  However, the Stewards advised Jockey Chau that he must react with more urgency in similar circumstances to correct his mounts.

She added when TURIN CHAMPIONS shifted to a one-off position near the 1100 Metres PRESTIGE GOOD was left racing without cover and as a result continued to race keenly and improved forward despite her efforts to restrain.  When questioned if there was an opportunity to allow her mount to stride forward approaching the 1000 Metres to avoid racing wide and to not continue to have to restrain her mount Apprentice Yuen stated that having regard to her instructions which included that she was to obtain cover and not lead, she elected to remain racing wide and without cover until near the 700 Metres. He said having regard to those instructions he was satisfied with the decision of Apprentice Yuen to not continue forward to lead in the middle stages.  After considering her explanation and taking into account her instructions the Stewards advised Apprentice Yuen that, in their opinion, she would have been better suited by allowing her mount to stride forward near the 1000 Metres and attempt to lead to avoid covering additional ground.

A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of VOYAGE BUBBLE was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, VOYAGE BUBBLE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
last_comments.BEAUTY JOY: B Avdulla reported that his mount was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event and as a result was unable to finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

last_comments.SMART GOLF: In the middle stages raced keenly and refused to settle. He added in the Home Straight his mount was disappointing in the manner in which it finished the race off.  Trainer F C Lor confirmed the instructions were to go forward and, in his opinion, SMART GOLF was disadvantaged by settling back in the field.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of SMART GOLF was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, SMART GOLF will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
last_comments.MAKE YOU SMILE: After travelling a short distance L Ferraris was required to reposition his right foot in his stirrup. last_comments.HAPPY SHOOTER: Between the 350 Metres and the 250 Metres had some difficulty obtaining clear running.
last_comments.JOYFUL JOY: When questioned J Orman stated that the instructions were to endeavour to be slightly more forward, however, JOYFUL JOY jumped awkwardly and then did not show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position.  He said during the event he followed FORTUNE BOY and making the Home Turn he elected to shift to the inside of FORTUNE BOY to improve, particularly as FORTUNE BOY shifted off on the Home Turn.  He said after improving behind SONIC LINER he was unable to identify a run available to the inside and for this reason near the 350 Metres he steadied and shifted his mount out across FORTUNE BOY and PRIME SUCCESS to obtain clear running.  He added after commencing to ride his mount along leaving the 250 Metres JOYFUL JOY then had further difficulty obtaining clear running between the 250 Metres and the 150 Metres.  He said after shifting to the outside of SHAMUS STORM, JOYFUL JOY then finished the race off well.  After considering the explanation the Stewards found the tactics adopted by Jockey Orman were reasonable in the circumstances.
last_comments.MASTER LUCKY: A Badel stated that the only explanation he could offer for the horse’s poor performance was that it was reluctant to race inside other horses.  Trainer J Size advised that the horse had pleased him leading into the race.  He said MASTER LUCKY has previously had a tendency to be reluctant to race inside other horses which may give its riders the impression that there is something amiss.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of MASTER LUCKY, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, MASTER LUCKY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

last_comments.KING ZOOM: Slow to begin. He said when ROAD TO GLORY did not improve into the race as he had expected he then shifted to the inside of that runner near the 300 Metres to secure clear running.  He added that his mount then commenced to finish the race off well but over the final 100 Metres could not be ridden out when it improved close to FLASH CURRENT. last_comments.GOOD GOOD: When questioned regarding the improved performance Trainer J Size stated that the horse races best when able to dictate in front without being challenged.  He said this was the reason for the horse’s improved performance today.  Sent for sampling post-race.

last_comments.MR INCREDIBLE: Bumped at the start.  When questioned K Teetan stated that his instructions were to settle the horse where comfortable and if possible obtain a position midfield with cover, particularly under its top weight of 135 lbs.  He said in the early stages when positioned to the outside of MAKE YOU SMILE, MR INCREDIBLE made contact with that runner when MAKE YOU SMILE shifted out slightly.  He said when caught wide to the outside of MAKE YOU SMILE, he contemplated following LA FORZA but when MR INCREDIBLE was not travelling well enough to do so he elected to obtain a trailing position behind MAKE YOU SMILE to save ground and allow the horse to travel where comfortable.  He added after following MAKE YOU SMILE in the middle stages he improved to that runner’s outside on entering the Home Straight where his mount finished the race off well.  Trainer B Crawford confirmed the instructions issued.  Sent for sampling post-race.
